correctness.rationale: On each finite chain, FC holds iff successive row maxima are monotone; BC iff successive column maxima are monotone. The proof establishes both directions including empty profiles, and establishes necessity/sufficiency of the two cross-incidence inequalities. The unique forced skeleton L sits in maximal envelope U, so all compatible relations form a disjoint Boolean cube; counting its free entries proves the exact polynomial. Nonempty relations contain bottom-right, forcing at least one overlap between row/column maxima and the sharp m+n−1 canonical sparsity. Dimension at most (m−1)(n−1), attained and uniquely so for m,n≥2 by all-last profiles. Actual standalone files independently test 74,650 matrices with quantified confluence, verify all square matrices through n=5, and compute counts through n=6. Finite computation supports, but is not substituted for, the proof.

value.rationale: A natural finite test class for intuitionistic modal frames with both FC and BC receives a complete exact structure, not only a numeric census: every frame has a unique pair of weakly increasing incidence profiles, feasible pairs are characterized by two explicit inequalities, every fiber is an independently parameterized Boolean cube, and the all-size arrow-count polynomial is exact. The minimum representative in every fiber has at most m+n−1 arrows, with a sharp extremal family. This separates arbitrary interior edge choices from necessary confluence witnesses, enabling exact counts and sparse representative construction for finite model research. The invariant counts all such accessibility relations and does not assert stronger modal preservation.
